title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: As part of climate interventions in ‘Le Chéile: Together for an inclusive better world, this project will address environmental concerns such as flooding and promote good Social Behaviour Change (SBC) towards climate change. The project will carry out SBC analysis to understand local communities’ attitudes towards climate and climate change, which will directly support the development of materials and activities to promote climate awareness among eye health centres and the wider communities.The risk and impact of flooding can be significantly increased by climate change. As a result, this project will aim to improve resilience to flooding through strengthening climate and environment sustainability guidelines, policies and supporting the development of green vision initiatives. Inadequate waste management causes blockage of drainage systems which can lead to flooding and mudslides in severe cases, limiting peoples access to health services. In response, this project will support the Sierra Leonean government’s integration of adaptive climate change actions by strengthening existing regulatory and policy framework. The project will support the review of the waste management policy in partner health centres to include climate and environmental approaches and develop a climate and environmental sustainability toolkit to support eye health programmes and health centres assess their vulnerability to the impact of climate change. Training on climate and environmental awareness for health workers will help to improve knowledge and perceptions of climate change.The green vision initiatives will include the use of renewable energy in the supported eye health facilities and introduce electronic medical recording (EMR) system. The improvement in renewable energy and efficiency through solar panels will contribute to the reduction in Greenhouse Gases (GHGs) and the EMR system will reduce the use of paper-based records and subsequent paper waste.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Increased integration of climate action initiatives, especially on climate adaptation and mitigation, into eye health and citizenship and political participation work in Sierra Leone.. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Adaptation:- Climate change adaptation is a significant motivation for the project. The project aims to increase the Sierra Leone governments adaptation to the impact and risk of flooding through strengthening waste management policies, developing a climate and environment sustainability toolkit for eye health programmes and health facilities. -Advocacy with ministries to strengthen existing regulatory and policy framework to include environmental considerations will promote positive impacts on the local and regional communities.Mitigation:- The development of green vision initiatives will reduce GHGs through renewable energy sources and reduction of paper waste via the EMR system.
